verdicts.evidence: The page shows only percentages, with no currency total and no fiscal 2025 comparison anywhere in the chart, legend, subtitle or source line.

The title reads "Where operating costs went in fiscal 2026" and the subtitle reads "Share of total operating costs by category, twelve months to 30 June 2026."; both describe the chart rather than state a finding.
The grey "Other" slice and legend row show 25%, the second-largest after Salaries at 38%, and nothing on the page says what it contains.
The slices carry only percentages, and the category names appear only in the legend at x≈620, roughly 100–300 px from the slices and linked by colour swatches (blue/purple and teal/grey among them).
